title: #088. Linearized CVaR Portfolio Optimization
subtitle: Optimize expected return against Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) using Rockafellar-Uryasev's exact linear formulation.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { weights, varThreshold, cvar, totalObjective }.
judge.m3: varThreshold ({p0}) yields Rockafellar-Uryasev value {p1}, which does not match minimum CVaR ({p2}).
judge.m4: Reported cvar ({p0}) does not match exact CVaR ({p1}) for the returned weights.
judge.m5: Reported totalObjective ({p0}) does not match expected loss plus riskWeight * CVaR ({p1}).
judge.m6: Feasible portfolio, but totalObjective ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
